### Question

What do you want to know? Be specific about what you have already tried.

### What you are working on

Project type, language, stack. If the question is about adapting a prompt to
your setup, this is the important part.

### Relevant prompt

Which file in the library are you asking about, if any? Link to it so the
answer can be specific rather than general.

### What you have already tried

Have you edited the prompt, the CONFIG block, or the project context section?
Sharing the diff often reveals the actual problem.
